why: A stepper press is not announced, so a screen-reader user who presses − or + hears nothing: focus stays on the button while the slider moves, which is the WCAG 4.1.3 status message the announcement exists for. (Follow-up to issue #918.)
killedBy: what a screen reader hears of the volume (follow-up to issue #918) a stepper press announces the level it ended on, once the presses stop
